main_tutorial.title: Step 1: Select a File
main_tutorial.text: Welcome to AutoVerse! To start, click the highlighted 'Browse' button to select an audio or video file you want to transcribe.

main_tutorial.title: Step 2: Identify Speakers
main_tutorial.text: If your audio has multiple speakers, check this box. This will automatically label who is speaking (e.g., SPEAKER_00, SPEAKER_01).

main_tutorial.title: Step 3: Include Timestamps
main_tutorial.text: It's highly recommended to include timestamps. This makes your transcript much easier to review and edit later. Ensure this box is checked.

main_tutorial.title: Step 4: Start Processing
main_tutorial.text: Great! All the main options are set. Click here to start processing. The tutorial will hide and reappear when it's finished.

main_tutorial.title: Step 5: View Your Transcript
main_tutorial.text: Congratulations! Your transcript appears here. The final step is to move to the Correction tab for advanced editing.

main_tutorial.title: Step 6: Head to Correction
main_tutorial.text: Click the 'Head to correction tab' button to open this transcript in the advanced editor. This will continue the tutorial.

main_tutorial.title: Step 7: The Correction Editor
main_tutorial.text: Welcome to the editor! Your files are loaded. This is where you'll do all your editing work.

main_tutorial.title: Step 8: Selecting Segments
main_tutorial.text: First, learn to select segments. Click on any segment to select it. Try clicking on different segments now.

main_tutorial.title: Step 9: Text Editing - Enter Edit Mode
main_tutorial.text: The most important feature! To edit text, double-click any segment to enter edit mode. Alternatively, you can select a segment and click the 'Edit Text' button. Try either method now.

main_tutorial.title: Step 10: Text Editing - Make Changes
main_tutorial.text: Now you're in edit mode! Make some changes to the text. You can fix typos, add punctuation, or rewrite sentences entirely.

main_tutorial.title: Step 11: Text Editing - Exit Edit Mode
main_tutorial.text: When done editing, click the 'Edit Text' button again to save your changes and exit edit mode. You can also click elsewhere to exit. Try this now, then click Next.

main_tutorial.title: Step 12: Audio Playback - Play/Pause
main_tutorial.text: Audio playback helps you verify your edits. Click the Play button to start audio playback.

main_tutorial.title: Step 13: Audio Playback - Timeline Navigation
main_tutorial.text: Click anywhere on the timeline to jump to that point in the audio. This is very useful for finding specific parts.

main_tutorial.title: Step 14: Audio Playback - Rewind/Forward
main_tutorial.text: Use the Rewind and Forward buttons to skip back or ahead by a few seconds. Both buttons are highlighted. Try them now, then click Next.

main_tutorial.title: Step 15: Splitting Segments - Select Text
main_tutorial.text: Sometimes you need to split one segment into two. First, double-click a segment to enter edit mode.

main_tutorial.title: Step 16: Splitting Segments - Position Cursor
main_tutorial.text: Now place your cursor exactly where you want to split the segment. This will become the boundary between two segments.

main_tutorial.title: Step 17: Add/Split Segments - Use the Button
main_tutorial.text: With your cursor positioned, click the 'Add/Split' button. This versatile button can split existing segments OR create entirely new segments. It will open a dialog with options.

main_tutorial.title: Step 18: Creating New Segments
main_tutorial.text: The 'Add/Split' button can also create completely new segments. Simply select any segment and click the button - you'll get options to add a new segment above or below the selected one.

main_tutorial.title: Step 19: Merging Segments - Select Multiple
main_tutorial.text: To merge segments, select multiple segments (they don't need to be consecutive). Hold Shift and click on segments. You can even select just one segment to merge it with the one above it.

main_tutorial.title: Step 20: Merging Segments - Use Merge Button
main_tutorial.text: Perfect! Now click the 'Merge' button to combine all selected segments into one single segment.

main_tutorial.title: Step 21: Deleting Segments - Select Target
main_tutorial.text: Sometimes you need to remove segments entirely. First, select one or more segments you want to delete.

main_tutorial.title: Step 22: Deleting Segments - Confirm Selection
main_tutorial.text: Make sure you have the right segments selected. You can select multiple segments with Shift+click if needed.

main_tutorial.title: Step 23: Deleting Segments - Use Delete Button
main_tutorial.text: Now click the 'Delete' button and confirm your choice in the popup dialog that appears.

main_tutorial.title: Step 24: Timestamp Editing - Select Segment
main_tutorial.text: Now let's learn timestamp editing. First, select a segment whose timestamp you want to adjust.

main_tutorial.title: Step 25: Timestamp Editing - Enter Edit Mode
main_tutorial.text: With a segment selected, click the 'Edit Timestamps' button to enter timestamp editing mode. Alternatively, you can double-click directly on the timestamp part of any segment.

main_tutorial.title: Step 26: Timestamp Editing - Adjust Time
main_tutorial.text: A cyan bar now marks the start time. Drag this bar, or use the playback controls to find the right spot. When ready, click Next.

main_tutorial.title: Step 27: Timestamp Editing - Save Changes
main_tutorial.text: Great! Now click the 'Save' button to confirm your new timestamp. To cancel, click the main 'Edit Timestamps' button again.

main_tutorial.title: Step 28: Speaker Management - Select Speaker Segment
main_tutorial.text: For speaker management, first select any segment that has a speaker label (like SPEAKER_00 or SPEAKER_01).

main_tutorial.title: Step 29: Speaker Management - Change Individual Speaker
main_tutorial.text: To change just this segment's speaker, click the 'Edit Speaker' button. Alternatively, you can double-click directly on the speaker part of any segment. This lets you reassign who is speaking.

main_tutorial.title: Step 30: Speaker Management - Rename All Speakers
main_tutorial.text: To rename speakers globally (e.g., change SPEAKER_00 to 'Alice' everywhere), click 'Assign Speaker Names'.

main_tutorial.title: Step 31: Undo and Redo - Mistake Recovery
main_tutorial.text: Made a mistake? No problem! Use 'Undo' to reverse your last action, or 'Redo' to bring it back. Both buttons are highlighted for you.

main_tutorial.title: Step 32: Saving Your Work - Export Changes
main_tutorial.text: Always save your work! Click 'Save Changes' to export your edited transcript to a new file.

main_tutorial.title: Step 33: Saving Your Work - Auto-Save
main_tutorial.text: Don't worry about losing work - your changes are also automatically saved every 2 minutes as you work.

main_tutorial.title: Step 34: Tutorial Complete!
main_tutorial.text: Congratulations! You've learned all the essential features. You can now efficiently edit transcripts, manage speakers, adjust timestamps, and more. Restart this tutorial anytime from the Help menu.
